notes.title: LOVISH Announcement - by LABS & Matt Kapp
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! This is Matt Kap! Some of you may know me from my work on [i]Astalon: Tears of the Earth[/i], [i]Castle In The Darkness[/i] and [i]The Binding Of Isaac: Rebirth[/i].

I’d like to introduce LABS' newest game that was just announced, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959010/Lovish/]LOVISH[/url][/b]! What started off as a side-project that I was messing around with in between [i]Castle In The Darkness 2[/i] tasks (that’s still going smoothly by the way) has become a full and proper game!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959010/Lovish/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34792571/bd2da814264e9dd8955936965f890ebb1f00b3c1.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]LOVISH[/b] is an action-adventure platformer that’s full of heart (get it?)! Play as Sir Solomon, as he quests through 50+ bite-sized stages in order to “rescue” the “love of his life”, Princess Tsuna, from the grasp of the evil Devil Lord! Between every stage, you will see a random event scene, in which anything could happen! Honestly, the less said the better, there are a lot of surprises. Find items, defeat monsters, see familiar faces, and collect crowns on your way to your showdown with Devil Lord!
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959010/Lovish/]Check out the LOVISH Demo on Steam[/url][/b]

[previewyoutube=ArKx1trh-28;full][/previewyoutube]
Working on [b]LOVISH[/b] has been the most fun I’ve had working on a videogame project, and I think that fun and light-heartedness shows through in the game itself. Available now, is a short and independent prologue demo that tells a little bit of the story up until the events of the main game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34792571/c1973571ed4e6731114951056ec70eac85e74949.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34792571/7c9263a77ac53fb2fd69af7d2cabe4031d4ea56e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34792571/c80b9600b328266c1a9331fe49460862cd4fd730.gif[/img]

I’d love to hear what you think, so please try it out and wishlist it :).
Thank you for all the support!

- Matt Kap

[h3]Sir Solomon’s Lovish Saga: A Quest for the Heart (Maybe)[/h3]
Sir Solomon and the Saviors of Light depart Castle Cornelius to free Princess Tsuna from the grasp of the evil Devil Lord! But the knight is worried... What if after being freed, the princess falls in love with one of his friends instead of with him? So he does what anyone would do when blinded by love, and ditches his friends! Solomon ventures into the Devil Lord's castle alone, vowing to steal the princess's heart.

LABS and Matt Kap present Lovish, an outrageous 8-bit-styled action-adventure game! Venture through a series of bite-sized rooms, slicing up monsters, collecting items and getting to the exit! After exiting each room, enjoy a short event scene, in which anything could happen! Will you find an item? A random encounter RPG fight? Will the world get destroyed? Find out by conquering each room of the Devil Lord's castle, one challenge at a time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34792571/e17e73428fda91f1acecc70aa0b5a7a8a9702648.jpg[/img]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 50+ fun levels to play through, each with multiple objectives!
[*] Wacky randomized event scenes between levels with hundreds of outcomes! You never know what you're gonna see next!
[*] Collect a variety of items to upgrade Solomon's abilities, or expand the game in meaningful (and unmeaningful) ways!
[*] Spend your pennies (in-game currency to be clear, no microtransactions here) in the in-game shop!
[*] 100+ characters, some of which were designed by world-famous manga artist Ryusuke Mita (Dragon Half)
[*] An exciting, 20+ tune soundtrack by Matt Kap (Castle In The Darkness, Astalon: Tears of the Earth)
[*] Beautiful human-artist-made pixel art! Even the in-game AI art is drawn by a human person!
[*] More secrets than ever before! (But this is the first game in this series, so that doesn't mean much, I guess.)
[*] Unexpected guest characters
[*] And lots more!
[/list]
So please, be a good friend, and help Solomon rescue the princess!

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959010/Lovish/]LOVISH on Steam[/url][/b]

notes.title: Astalon Art and Creation, Bonus Tracks Album and Fan Art Contest!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! This month was something special! "Astalon: Tears of the Earth" turned 2 years old ! Part of the celebrations included new digital goods and some new contests and giveaways! 

First, we're having a fanart contest! Drawings, music, stories- anything counts! Share your creation, tag @LABSworks on twitter or instagram, and use the hashtag #astalonfanartcontest ! We have some awesome prizes to give away. Full rules at the link below:

https://astalonart.dangenentertainment.com/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34792571/0a7b60924cb9c3db7de5ebcea84f424ad8604e8d.png[/img]

Next thing, we have released the artbook "Art and Creation" on Steam as well!  This is over 100 pages that include every piece of official Astalon art, and a ton of behind the scenes info, lore, and interviews that will greatly interest fans of the game! You can buy it at the link below 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2452360/Astalon_Tears_of_the_Earth__Art_and_Creation/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34792571/d2e5fc5ed1d12de287d09ce570ec23c9048636dd.png[/img]

And finally, we have released a 3rd soundtrack album, which compiles all the bonus tracks from the Limited Run Games collector's edition soundtrack release! This album has 6 chiptunes that were cut from the game, as well as 6 new super arrange tracks by Matt Kap! You can buy it now on Steam or bandcamp, or listen on your favorite music streaming service!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34792571/e7bc2214aa00250b91766fa3bdcfe13983c3928d.png[/img]

notes.title: Astalon: Tears of the Earth - Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for your continued support and your great feedback, we're humbled and couldn't have wished for a nicer community! As a thank you we wanted to something a tiny bit special and we hope that you'll enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed designing it!


[b]GAME UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS[/b]

For all the peeps that can't get enough of Astalon, we've added a whole new mode! Please welcome a real NEW GAME + mode! Not only you'll now be able to dive back into the tower with your power ups after the end of the normal game, but you'll now be able to discover a cool new take on the tower itself! New visuals, new room layouts, new secrets, new challenges await you in the Tower of Serpents!

[b]PHYSICAL EDITION[/b]

For those of you who haven't heard, we're working with the awesome people at Limited Run Games to bring "Astalon: Tears of the Earth" to real Switch cartridges and PS4 discs! There will be 2 editions. First up is the standard game case (with brand new Ryusuke Mita cover art, and a retro-style manual). And second- the COLLECTORS EDITION BOX!  The CE box features a 3-disc deluxe soundtrack with a whole album worth of unreleased music, a huge development art book with tons of behind-the-scenes info, sketches, art, lore and trivia, and more! Pre-orders are open now at the URL below: 

https://limitedrungames.com/collections/astalon-tears-of-the-earth

Remember, it's a limited release, so you have to pre-order a copy before Feb 20th. So, what are you waiting for :D?

[b]COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS[/b]

We also have some very good new to share! The amazing speedrunning community of Astalon did a tremendous job at running the game, finding routes and doing friendly competitions with one another, and as a result to their hard work, @strizer86 did a great, very suspenseful live run of the game during AGDQ 2022 in January! Congratulations to him, to Colt for managing Astalon's speedrunning community and for his awesome work as a commentator during the run! And thank you to the whole speedrunning community, we couldn't be more proud! 

Make sure to check out the run below!

[b]PATCH HIGHLIGHTS[/b]

[list]
[*] Added New Game Plus mode with a modified and tweaked map! (start a new game from a normal save file with a "cleared" tag on it)
[*] Made numerous fixes to the main map
[*] Added a copy/paste feature for save files in the saves menu
[*] Fixed Void Portals not appearing on the map
[*] Fixed orbs not spawning anymore after playing the game for a while
[*] Changed the Bestiary achievements to trigger the previous ones too as a safety
[*] Ukrainian translation fixes with the help of SBT Localization Team
[*] Added Russian translation credits
[*] Fixed Gate not registering as opened when you hit a teleporter at the exact same time
[*] Added more screen resolutions between 1280 and 1680
[*] Added the option to keep a button pressed to skip dialogues faster (no more button mashing! Keeping the Jump button pressed with now auto-complete dialogues)
[*] Added potential fix for characters moving on their own after a character swap
[*] Added a potential fix for characters blinking through platforms on some occasions
[*] Various small fixes
[/list]

[previewyoutube=6DQJjeNUg9c;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Astalon: Tears of the Earth releases June 3rd, 2021! New trailer revealed!
notes.notes:
We are excited to finally announce the release date of [b]Astalon: Tears of the Earth[/b], coming to Steam on June 3rd! We also have a brand new trailer that reveals a closer glimpse into the world of Astalon and a snippet from the upcoming arrange album.

[previewyoutube=iRbkhvukuh8;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1046400/]Astalon: Tears of the Earth ｌ Steam Store Page[/url]

[b]Astalon: Tears of the Earth[/b] is a 2D action-platformer that follows three unique warriors on a perilous mission to save their town in a post-apocalyptic world. Having made a pact with the Titan of Death, Epimetheus, the characters are granted the power to grow stronger each time they die and must surmount the mysterious Tower of Serpents in search of answers. Players can switch between the three heroes and must utilize their unique skills to take down monsters, solve puzzles, find artifacts, and progress through the game, all while uncovering the intriguing backstory behind the Titan, the tower and the heroes.
